hypothesis: The measured SIMD candidates (164618338efd47c5 at 0.081288 s and e2786cc8e1da48a4 at 0.082253 s) are close, while the no-directive pointer-induction candidate 2d936b92faa04fe4 measured 0.449431 s and also changed the access form. This experiment uses indexed x accesses through hoisted row bases without a SIMD directive to test whether a compiler-vectorizable loop can approach the explicit-SIMD results. It assumes no alignment or vector width; the ordinary loop covers every valid width and tail. The controller should validate the fixed tolerance and measure both core budgets including setup costs.
notes: The catalog reports three distinct valid programs and no repeats. No speedup is claimed for this unmeasured candidate.
